title: No video is a better failure than a video in the wrong voice.

facts.quote: If the channel’s voice cannot be reached, the run stops: it never switches to another voice.
Before anything is paid for, the run checks that the voice and the picture models the channel is set to can really be reached.
When a channel is set to a particular voice, model or source and it is not available, the run stops and says what to fix. It does not quietly use something worse.
No video is a better failure than a video in the wrong voice.
If the run fails or does not finish, the whole hold comes back and nothing is charged
A failed run returns it all.
Every upload is private, and nothing goes public unless you make it public or turn on a setting that does.
Your 100 free credits cover about 1 min of finished video at this rate.
